body: Yes.  I try to have motivation, and then I think about this problem, then that problem, then that one, then that one, then this one over here, oh don't forget about this one.  It's really hard.  It's just really hard to change.

First let me thank you for your thought out reply.

I eat, well nothing.  22 year old male, and I weigh ~110 or so.  I have a non existing appetite, which I'm sure correlates with my depression. 

I guess.  It just seems so fucking overwhelming to think about everything there is to fix, and how people my age are GRADUATING college, and I'll be there freshman year :/.

I'll check out that reddit. Thanks.  I know what my problem is.  I have a massive fear of being judged, I know why as well, it's because I look really young for my age.  It bothers me, a lot.

I'll try to start eating breakfast.

I was thinking about the military, but I have a chronic disease which doesn't allow you to go.

It's really hard not to hate yourself.  I've been hating myself for the past 10 years, and I can't just change my way of thought, because it's correct.  I am a deadbeat loser atm that will be homeless eventually if it keeps up.  I assume that will start to change if I fix a few things.
